description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Moldervine Reclamation, causing you to gain 1 life and drawing you a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.
